title: export resolution picker
description:
The export sheet's MP4 path gains the resolution ladder (owner request
2026-11-13): Original / UHD 3840x2160 / FHD 1920x1080 / HD 1280x720 /
Custom w+h, each chip showing the size it RESOLVES to for this clip,
Original star-marked as the recommendation, and every non-Original entry
carrying its honest downscale/equal/upscale flag — an upscale is
explicitly marked, never the default. The size decision and the framing
decision stay separate: a 4:3 source at FHD resolves to 1440x1080 (its
own aspect at the bound), and the export scale step is an
aspect-preserving RgbScale.aspectFit (symmetric bars only when the
resolved bound and the effective size disagree), never a center-crop.

The chain: the sheet (EditorTopBar) computes the ladder from the
session's recorded frame size composed with the manual rotation and the
crop, the tap carries the RESOLVED bound through the widened
onExport(Target
